lines: Christopher Merrill, co-founder and CEO of Harrison Street, details the scaling of his $110 billion alternative real assets firm, which focuses on demographic-driven, need-based sectors like student housing and senior living.
Merrill emphasizes that targeting assets with consistent demand across economic cycles insulates the portfolio from market timing risks and avoids reliance on excessive leverage.
The firm's growth strategy relies on aggregating fragmented, operationally intensive assets into institutional-grade portfolios while embedding rigorous quality control models such as Six Sigma.
podcast: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: Alternative Real Assets at $110 billion Harrison Street – Christopher Merrill (EP.529)
